title: Igrot Kodesh - Letter No. 191
summary_researcher: Authorized English publication of Letter 191 to R. Chanoch Hendel Havlin. The page explicitly presents the letter as a response to the recipient's letters, especially his letter of 25 Tammuz, and contains an editorial cross-reference to Letter 179. The incoming correspondence and underlying Hebrew witness were not inspected.
